plain: A guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, in an episode about secrets of the Moon, talks about "mascons", patches of the Moon where its gravity is unevenly strong. The guest says the Apollo spacecraft, NASA's crewed Moon missions of the 1960s and 70s, ran into trouble with their orbits and landings because of this. It is told as a sign that the Moon's inside is stranger than it looks.
